authority: Plan 12.13 v3 (sha256 26653bbc2123e66d990d37977f9ab81a6ded9121de7594e358b0c9fdad31ffa0) section #242 and decision D3, approved by the operator 2026-11-23 ('Approve hash + D1-D4')
applies_to: ordinary workspace assembly (src/optimus/agent/workspace_context.py, the AMBIGUOUS_WORKSPACE_REFERENCE stop)

eligibility.rule: FilePolicy and scope decide the candidate set exactly as today; ranking only orders that set
preserved: secret and ignore-file denials: a denied file is never a candidate and is never shown
exact workspace-relative path resolution, including the existing backslash-to-slash normalization
the existing unique-name rule: one admitted current target resolves automatically
deterministic fallback when no index is configured
eligibility.data_authority: file, symbol and metadata text never gains instruction authority

hints.allowed: only verified-current structural hints: a record whose file hash matches the file's current bytes in the current index generation
hints.missing_or_stale: contributes nothing and never removes an eligible candidate

features.name: task_term_relevance
features.definition: count of distinct terms in context_engine.retrieval.lexical_terms(task text) that also occur in context_engine.code_index.split_terms of the candidate's directory components, plus, when the candidate's metadata is verified-current, of its record labels (symbol names, Markdown headings)
features.exclusions: terms of the ambiguous reference itself (its basename and extension) are removed from the task terms before counting

features.name: dependency_proximity
features.definition: 1 when the candidate is in context_engine.repo_map.neighbours(verified-current map files, independently resolved task paths), else 0
features.bounds: depth 1 only (what the resolved paths import, then what imports them); edges come only from verified-current records of either endpoint; an independently resolved task path is one the task names that resolves under the existing exact-path or unique-name rules; not build resolution

features.name: verified_current_metadata
features.definition: 1 when the candidate has a verified-current index record, else 0

features.name: path
features.definition: workspace-relative POSIX path, compared by Unicode code point (Python str ordering); the final, total tie-break

not_used: global utility functions, RRF retuning or any change to M1 fusion

threshold.automatic_resolution: only one admitted current target under the existing exact-path or unique-name rules
threshold.multiple_eligible: stays ambiguous regardless of score or gap: a visible stop listing every eligible candidate in ranked order, each with its reasons (feature values), and asking for one exact workspace-relative path
threshold.retry: the exact path is revalidated (eligibility, existence, current hash) before any read or edit; failure is a typed stop for that path, never a fallback to another candidate
threshold.no_new_dialogue: no new confirmation dialogue; ranking never authorizes a target

baseline.name: path_only
baseline.definition: today's order: ascending workspace-relative path (by_basename tuples are sorted in workspace_context._build_eligible_file_index)
